title: Micro-Economic Theory I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the techniques and methods employed in the production process."
Technology in this context is the techniques and methods employed in the production process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the scientific management of production line, exchange and consumption."
Allocation of resources is the scientific management of production line, exchange and consumption.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means increase in supply while a leftward shift of the supply curve indicates a cut or reduction in supply."
A rightwards shift means increase in supply while a leftward shift of the supply curve indicates a cut or reduction in supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the impossibility of dividing a factor into smaller units."
Indivisibility means the impossibility of dividing a factor into smaller units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to return or earning accrued to a factor of production in excess of the minimum amount necessary to keep it in its present use."
Economics rent refers to return or earning accrued to a factor of production in excess of the minimum amount necessary to keep it in its present use.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a curve that shows how average cost varies with output on the assumption that all factors are variable."
Long-run average cost curve (LRAC) is a curve that shows how average cost varies with output on the assumption that all factors are variable.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the quantity of goods and services a consumer is willing and able to buy, at given price and at a particular period of time."
Demand may be defined as the quantity of goods and services a consumer is willing and able to buy, at given price and at a particular period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical expression of the relationship between two or more economic variables."
A function is a mathematical expression of the relationship between two or more economic variables.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a line showing how a person's optimum level of consumption of two goods changes as the price of one of the goods changes (assuming that income and the price of the other goods remain constant)."

The price consumption curve is a line showing how a person's optimum level of consumption of two goods changes as the price of one of the goods changes (assuming that income and the price of the other goods remain constant).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the locus of point involving different combination of goods which yield the same level of utility to the consumer so that he is indifferent among them."
An indifference curve is the locus of point involving different combination of goods which yield the same level of utility to the consumer so that he is indifferent among them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the needs that are left unsatisfied in order to satisfy another more pressing one."
Opportunity cost refers to the needs that are left unsatisfied in order to satisfy another more pressing one.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool for drawing the demand curve."
A demand schedule is a tool for drawing the demand curve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to calculate the value of an unknown variable."
Equations are used to calculate the value of an unknown variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the period of time that is long enough for new firms to enter the industry."
The long man is the period of time that is long enough for new firms to enter the industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simplified representation of a situation."
A model is a simplified representation of a situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means all human effort employed in the production of goods and services."
Labour means all human effort employed in the production of goods and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital tool of economic analysis in modern times."
Slope is a vital tool of economic analysis in modern times.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of economics which focuses on the actions of the individual agents in the economy."
Microeconomics is a branch of economics which focuses on the actions of the individual agents in the economy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is termed as X axis and the vertical line termed as Y axis."
The horizontal line is termed as X axis and the vertical line termed as Y axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the transformation of inputs into outputs by firms in order to earn profit."
Production is the transformation of inputs into outputs by firms in order to earn profit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to excess of human wants over what can actually be produced to fulfill these wants (Abe, 2000)."
Scarcity refers to excess of human wants over what can actually be produced to fulfill these wants (Abe, 2000).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Latin Phrase meaning, "all things being equal"."
Ceteris Paribus is a Latin Phrase meaning, "all things being equal".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to desire or wish to have something."
Want literally refers to desire or wish to have something.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the amount of a commodity a producer are willing and able to offer for sale at a stated price and at a given period of time."
Supply means the amount of a commodity a producer are willing and able to offer for sale at a stated price and at a given period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the advantages a firm derive from increase in production that goes on to reduce the cost of production as a result internal."
Internal economies of scale are the advantages a firm derive from increase in production that goes on to reduce the cost of production as a result internal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that utility could be rankled as various levels of consumption."
Ordinarily of utility means that utility could be rankled as various levels of consumption.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the major problems faced by every economy-primitive or modern."
Scarcity and choice are the major problems faced by every economy-primitive or modern.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the responsiveness of demand (or supply) to a change in one of the determinants."
Elasticity is a measure of the responsiveness of demand (or supply) to a change in one of the determinants.
fib: ______ refers to the machinery; tools and buildings humans use to produce goods and services.
Capital
Capital refers to the machinery; tools and buildings humans use to produce goods and services.
______ is the most commonly used tool in modern economics.
Graph
Graph is the most commonly used tool in modern economics.
______ is an economy in which there exists some government intervention.
mixed market economy
A mixed market economy is an economy in which there exists some government intervention.
______ is the proportional change in quantity demanded of a commodity to the proportional change in the price of the commodity.
Price elasticity of demand
Price elasticity of demand is the proportional change in quantity demanded of a commodity to the proportional change in the price of the commodity.
______ refers to the number of workers that would offer themselves for employment at each possible wage rate and the quantity of labour supplied.
Supply of labour
Supply of labour refers to the number of workers that would offer themselves for employment at each possible wage rate and the quantity of labour supplied.
______ is the graphical representation of the relationship between price and quantity demanded of a commodity the graphical representation of the demand schedule.
demand curve
A demand curve is the graphical representation of the relationship between price and quantity demanded of a commodity the graphical representation of the demand schedule.
______ refers to an important thing which magnitude can change.
variable
A variable refers to an important thing which magnitude can change.
______ means the cost of any activity measured in terms of best alternative forgone.
Opportunity cost simply
Opportunity cost simply means the cost of any activity measured in terms of best alternative forgone.
______ is a rational process which is very easy to calculate.
Economists explain that price determination
Economists explain that price determination is a rational process which is very easy to calculate.
______ is an annunciation of independent firm writing an industry.
cartel
A cartel is an annunciation of independent firm writing an industry.
______ refers to the process of shifting services formerly undertaken by public sector into the private sector in order for efficiency to be achieved.
Privatization simply
Privatization simply refers to the process of shifting services formerly undertaken by public sector into the private sector in order for efficiency to be achieved.
______ refers to the ability of a consumer to derive the highest level of satisfaction from consuming a given commodity or service.
Utility maximization
Utility maximization refers to the ability of a consumer to derive the highest level of satisfaction from consuming a given commodity or service.
______ refers to a fraction of total output.
Supply in economics
Supply in economics refers to a fraction of total output.
______ is concerned about production of goods and services as well as consumption of goods and services.
Economics
Economics is concerned about production of goods and services as well as consumption of goods and services.
______ refers to income resulting from machines and other man-made appliances.
Quasi-rent
Quasi-rent refers to income resulting from machines and other man-made appliances.
______ is the act of using goods and services: labour, land, raw-materials and capital.
Consumption on the other hand
Consumption on the other hand is the act of using goods and services: labour, land, raw-materials and capital.
______ is the quantity of a commodity that would be bought by an individual or household at any given price at a particular period of time.
individual demand
The individual demand is the quantity of a commodity that would be bought by an individual or household at any given price at a particular period of time.
______ is the representation or listing of wants in order of relative importance.
Scale of preference
Scale of preference is the representation or listing of wants in order of relative importance.
______ is the redirection of publicly owned welfare providing ventures into profit marking venture.
Commercialization
Commercialization is the redirection of publicly owned welfare providing ventures into profit marking venture.
______ is the concept adopted to explain limited supply o f resources to meet the unlimited and ever increasing human wants.
Scarcity as an economic concept
Scarcity as an economic concept is the concept adopted to explain limited supply o f resources to meet the unlimited and ever increasing human wants.
______ refers to the lowest wage permitted by law or agreement.
Minimum wage
Minimum wage refers to the lowest wage permitted by law or agreement.
______ refers to the monetary value of all resources (human and material (resources) used in the production of a commodity.
Cost of production
Cost of production refers to the monetary value of all resources (human and material (resources) used in the production of a commodity.
______ is a tabular presentation of the relationship between the quantities of goods supplied at various prices.
supply schedule
A supply schedule is a tabular presentation of the relationship between the quantities of goods supplied at various prices.
______ is a major tool of economic analysis in modern times.
Mathematics
Mathematics is a major tool of economic analysis in modern times.
______ is an economic system in which production and investment decisions are made by central authority, usually by a public body such as a government agency.
planned economy
A planned economy is an economic system in which production and investment decisions are made by central authority, usually by a public body such as a government agency.
______ is an oligopoly where there are just two firms in the industry.
Duopoly
Duopoly is an oligopoly where there are just two firms in the industry.
______ refer to additional cost of doing one more unit or a little more of an activity.
Marginal costs
Marginal costs refer to additional cost of doing one more unit or a little more of an activity.
